identification: Unsigned small oil (board or canvas) of a sandy bay with dark headland cliffs, a red-sailed boat and distant sails, gulls, rocks with a beached boat lower right; image about 15 x 30 cm. Amateur/provincial work, late Victorian or Edwardian (c.1890-1915), typical British/colonial 'coastal scene' souvenir painting. In its period frame: wide quarter-sawn oak with a chip-carved pyramid (nailhead) outer border and a pressed-metal/composition gilt scroll slip. Armitage estimate A$20-40.
